carry.question: Aux is new on Aux, which is new too, and Update SolidWorks adds a gear only on a shaft the layout part has, so the gearbox needs building again. Shaft Aux is new, and the layout part has no axis for it. Gear_m1.25_N29 (Sun): Flank changed from involute to arcs, which its values cannot carry, so it needs a new part. Build again as RangeBox_r2? That makes new parts for Sun (Gear_m1.25_N29_r2) and Aux (Gear_m1.25_N20), reuses 4 parts that have not changed and makes a new layout part, carrier part and assembly (RangeBox_r2_Layout, RangeBox_r2_Carrier_Carrier and RangeBox_r2.SLDASM). Nothing is overwritten, and RangeBox.SLDASM stays as it is on disk, but it shares the 4 reused parts: a later Update SolidWorks that changes one of them changes RangeBox.SLDASM too. As read at 15:56, RangeBox_r2 takes your Chain-1, Sprocket-3, Sprocket-4 and 14 other components and makes your 26 mates again in the modes each was on in. UserSunFace was on a face of Sun, and Sun's part is new because its Flank changed, so it is not made again. SolidWorks would not describe UserGear6 wholly (its gear ratio could not be read), so it is not made again. SolidWorks would not describe UserAxis9 wholly, so it is not made again. UserGearRoot was on a face of Sun, and Sun's part is new because its Flank changed, so it is not made again. UserGearFillet was on a face of Sun, and Sun's part is new because its Flank changed, so it is not made again. Sprocket-9 was suppressed in the mode RangeBox.SLDASM showed, as read: show a mode where it is resolved before you press, or it may not be carried. Your User Keyway Sketch and User Keyway stay in Gear_m1.25_N29, which Sun's new part replaces (its Flank changed). RangeBox_r2 holds what it carries unsaved. If RangeBox.SLDASM is closed, open it first unless this SolidWorks last saved it and its files, those files are where it says, and nothing of yours is open. Assembly features, display states and appearances stay behind; sub-assemblies come over rigid, pattern instances as components of their own.

Drag Sun in SolidWorks and the rest of its train follow. RangeSlv slides along Output, to its place in each mode.
